description: Mapa de Risco de Desmatamento para Bioma Mata Atlântica - Minas Gerais (2000 a 2017) [CNPS] is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Analise do risco de desmatamento do bioma Mata Atlântica, para 10 municípios do estado de Minas Gerais, considerando a vulnerabilidade deste bioma a presença humana e as caracteristicas naturais do espaço analisado. Considerando a metodologia desenvolvida por Tipper and Bournazel (2016), denominada Hectares Indicator (KPI 8). [CNPS]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are CNPS, Desmatamento evitado, Hectares, Indicator, mata atlântica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
